definitions.explanation: The relationship between time invested and results gained. Short for タイムパフォーマンス.

examples.english: I watch videos at double speed to prioritize time efficiency.

examples.english: More young people are acting with time efficiency in mind.

notes:
タイパ is an abbreviation of タイムパフォーマンス (time performance), meaning time efficiency.

ETYMOLOGY:
Modeled after ⟦コスパ→コスパ：04739_kosupa⟧, from English "time performance." Gained popularity among younger generations in the 2020s.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- タイパ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: time-efficient
- タイパ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: time-inefficient
- タイパ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重視|じゅうし}→重視：03341_juushi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to prioritize time efficiency

CULTURAL NOTE:
Reflects a cultural shift toward valuing efficiency. Young people often watch videos at ⟦{倍速|ばいそく}→倍速：25707_baisoku⟧ (double speed) or skip slow parts to save time.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦コスパ→コスパ：04739_kosupa⟧: cost-performance (value for money)
- ⟦{時短|じたん}→時短：18970_jitan⟧: time-saving
